method.statistic: Median of per-observation paired numerator/denominator latency ratios.
method.resampling_unit: Within-file and cache paired timing block; random/reverse remain together.
method.interval: Percentile 95%; conditional within-run timing uncertainty, not document-population uncertainty.

interpretation.ratio_above_one: Fixed union is faster than the named native interface.
interpretation.native_raw: Original log2-LSE API; the stricter comparison for a union engineering benefit because it adds no conversion work to native.
interpretation.native: Natural-log LSE with conversion timed; an interface-matched comparison.
interpretation.dynamic_v2: The original dynamic-row proposal remains no-go in the completed feasibility study; this analysis does not reopen it.
interpretation.native_comparator_scope: Best tested configurations qualified under the existing O/LSE tolerances; not an unrestricted claim over all FlashInfer implementations or configurations.
interpretation.stronger_joint_paged_prefill_control: Included in the joint_prefill files below; exact custom-mask native execution tests whether the earlier decode-only signal is covered by an existing native interface.
interpretation.claim_scope: Existing masked-union execution engineering signal only; no novelty, application quality or net application benefit claim.

joint_prefill_conclusion.baseline: FlashInfer 0.7.2 joint-query paged prefill with exact custom mask, sharing the physical KV source.
joint_prefill_conclusion.comparison_scope: Each native joint arm is paired against this run's own tuned union; no ratio of results from different runs.
joint_prefill_conclusion.conclusion: All measured hot raw joint-native interfaces are faster than the local fixed union. Including ln conversion leaves only a small local-union advantage, below the 1.15 signal threshold in every cache case. The earlier decode-only advantage does not establish a new union mechanism or justify integration; dynamic-row no-go remains unchanged.

limits: Four snapshots comprise three official-4B documents; repeated layers and interfaces do not add independent documents.
Cold raw ratios near one are affected by single-call timestamp quantization; do not generalize the hot result to every cache regime.
Numerically rejected configurations are recorded and excluded; comparison covers the qualified tuning grid, not every possible native implementation.

independence_note: Layers, steps, cache regimes and repeated timing blocks are not additional documents. No across-file pooled significance test or quality estimate is computed.
limitations: Cold single-call timestamp quantization can produce narrow or degenerate intervals.
A/A is reported per file and cache, not used to manufacture a cross-document confidence claim.
Raw provenance, selected tuning configurations and scope are preserved per file.
Numerically rejected native/native_raw configurations are excluded by the benchmark; their counts and full failure reasons are preserved here.
There is no separate formal artifact establishing native-calibrated freezing of the O atol=0.006, rtol=0.015 tolerance; do not claim unrestricted numerical equivalence.
Missing files/shapes/pairs stay pending; malformed completed records are invalid, never silently dropped.
